<includeonly><div class="progress" style="position:relative;">
  <p style="position: absolute; width: 100%; line-height: 21px; text-align: center; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0;">'''20'''个内容页面：{{#expr: {{NUMBEROFARTICLES:R}} div 20 * 100 round 1}}%</p>
  <div class="progress-bar progress-bar-warning progress-bar-striped active" role="progressbar" aria-valuenow=“100” aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="1500" style="width: {{#expr: {{NUMBEROFARTICLES:R}} div 20 * 100}}%;"></div>
</div>
<div class="progress" style="position:relative;">
  <p style="position: absolute; width: 100%; line-height: 21px; text-align: center; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0;">'''200'''次编辑：{{#expr: {{NUMBEROFEDITS:R}} div 200 * 100 round 1}}%</p>
  <div class="progress-bar progress-bar-info progress-bar-striped active" role="progressbar" aria-valuenow="{{NUMBEROFEDITS:R}}" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="1000" style="width: {{#expr: {{NUMBEROFEDITS:R}} div 200 * 100}}%;"></div>
</div>
<div class="progress" style="position:relative;">
  <p style="position: absolute; width: 100%; line-height: 21px; text-align: center; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0;">'''20'''人关注：{{#expr: {{NUMBEROFFOLLOWERS:R}} div 20 * 100 round 1}}%</p>
  <div class="progress-bar progress-bar-primary progress-bar-striped active" role="progressbar" aria-valuenow="{{NUMBEROFFOLLOWERS:R}}" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="1000" style="width: {{#expr: {{NUMBEROFFOLLOWERS:R}} div 20 * 100}}%;"></div>
</div>
